name: EstiBot
description: Domain appraisals, keyword metrics, website information, leads and drop/zone data through the current EstiBot API. Requires Advanced or Expert API access. Lookups count against plan quotas. Personal/internal-use licensing applies; organizations with more than three employees and redistribution require an appropriate license. Documentation: https://github.com/domainret/estibot-api.

credential_fields.name: api_key
credential_fields.label: API Key
credential_fields.description: Sign up at https://www.estibot.com/register for an API-enabled Advanced or Expert account, then use its API key. Confirm the provider's organization and data-use licensing requirements at https://github.com/domainret/estibot-api.

tools.name: appraise_domain
tools.description: Appraise one domain, returning all valuation and supporting fields. mode=auto uses recent cache or live lookup; live can take about three seconds per domain. Only one appraisal query may be in flight.

domain.description: Domain name without a scheme, path, or port, e.g. example.com.

tools.name: appraise_domains
tools.description: Appraise up to 200 domains in cache or live mode. Choose cache for a fast initial lookup; auto is unsupported for batches. Preserve top-level not_found and cache fields. A live batch may take five minutes. Only one appraisal query may be in flight.

domains.description: Domains separated by >>, e.g. example.com>>startup.net. Up to 200 names. Wait for each appraisal request to finish before the next.

mode.description: Batch lookup mode. Choose cache first, then live for domains returned in not_found.

tools.name: generate_leads
tools.description: Generate end-user leads for one domain, optionally combined with a keyword. Consumes plan quota; allow up to 60 seconds and only one lead query at a time.

domain.description: Domain name without a scheme, path, or port, e.g. example.com.

keyword.description: Optional keyword to combine with the domain, e.g. fast cars.

tools.name: get_keyword_metrics
tools.description: Retrieve keyword search volume and CPC. Supply keywords, not domains to be automatically parsed. Separate multiple keywords with >>. Provider permits up to three concurrent keyword queries.

keywords.description: One or more keyword phrases separated by >>, e.g. car insurance>>fast cars.

tools.name: get_site_info
tools.description: Retrieve crawl information including site usage, title and public contact/MX data for domains separated by >>. Provider permits up to three concurrent site-info queries.

tools.name: get_drop_list
tools.description: Generate a drop-list download and return the full JSON envelope containing the compressed CSV URL. Maximum 20 downloads/day, one query at a time. Dates must meet the provider's current list-date restrictions.

list.description: List name, e.g. available, namejet pre-release or pendingdelete.

tools.name: get_zone_changes
tools.description: Generate a ZIP/CSV URL for new or deleted domains. Maximum 25 downloads/day, one query at a time. Download URLs expire after one hour. Returns JSON rather than following a direct-file redirect.
